description.text: AI-written synthesis of the cited official pages, prepared by the collecting assistant: The 500 Fellowship is 500 Global's flagship Program for early-stage founders building for the U.S. and the world. The four-month, in-person San Francisco Program combines a founder cohort, expert mentorship, weekly group work and individual support. The checked page advertises November 30, 2026 to April 9, 2027. Accepted companies can receive up to $50,000 immediately, with the potential for up to $1 million more as they progress; this is not a guaranteed $1.05 million investment. The page does not publish fixed equity, an investment instrument, or an application deadline, and applying does not guarantee investment.

sources.title: 500 Global — official brand mark linked from the flagship page
The 500 Fellowship — official overview
sources.quote:
The 500 Fellowship is 500 Global's flagship program in San Francisco for early-stage founders building for the U.S. and the world.
It’s four months in San Francisco, California with your cohort, Unicorn founders, and top VCs in Silicon Valley.
Weekly group day, 1:1s, and a focus on the few risks that matter most before your next round.

sources.title: The 500 Fellowship — who it is for
sources.quote:
This is for the top 0.1% of founders. We meet builders as early as day 0 who have a nonobvious deep insight on the market and an unfair advantage to get to the people who need it the most.
We’re looking for founders who've started building and thinking globally already. You might have just started or you already have your first users, revenue or pilots. You're in the U.S. already, or you plan to be within six months.

sources.title: The 500 Fellowship — published investment description
sources.quote: Companies accepted into the 500 Fellowship can receive up to $50K right away with the potential for up to $1M more as you progress.

sources.title: The 500 Fellowship — investment disclaimer
sources.quote: THIS WEBPAGE IS UPDATED AS OF SEP 2026. APPLYING TO THE PROGRAM DOES NOT GUARANTEE AN INVESTMENT FROM 500 GLOBAL, OR ITS RESPECTIVE AFFILIATES.
